criteria.ac: Given no autonomous.runner_github_token_env is configured, when faff makes any gh call, then the spawned gh environment is byte-identical to the ambient process environment (no GH_TOKEN set, cleared, or reordered by faff).
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "resolveRunnerGhEnv: zero-config is byte-identical — env returned by reference, no GH_TOKEN added" (ambient branch returns env by reference, merge-gate.js:352) plus "conformance: no bare spawnSync(\"gh\" remains outside runGh across the 9-site surface; ghJson delegates to runGh" — node --test 18/18 passing

criteria.ac: Given autonomous.runner_github_token_env names a non-empty token in process.env, when runGh spawns any gh call, then GH_TOKEN in the child env equals that token value, read fresh at the moment of the call, and identitySource is "runner-credential".
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "resolveRunnerGhEnv: a configured, resolvable credential injects GH_TOKEN and masks it in redactedEnv" — passing

criteria.ac: Given a runner credential resolved and gh api user returns an authed login, when the run records its identity evidence, then a runner-identity record is appended to events.jsonl carrying {github_login:<login>, github_login_source:"gh-api-user", credential_source:"runner-credential", credential_unresolved:false, verified:true} and no token value.
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "resolveRunnerIdentity: authed probe → gh-api-user login, verified true" + "eventViolations: a well-formed runner-identity record is accepted" + "redaction: token absent from events.jsonl and merge-record.json after a configured-credential run" — passing

criteria.ac: Given a run recorded its runner identity and the per-PR anchor is minted at head SHA H, when the committed anchor's events.jsonl is read at H and its chain-head.json is verified, then the runner-identity record is present in the anchored log, chain-head.json head_sha256 matches the log's last line, and the identity Gate 1 consumes comes from this anchored copy, never the live run-dir file.
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "runner-identity reaches the committed anchor: present in anchored events.jsonl + chain-head matches the last line" — passing; spec section 4 names the anchored copy (not the live file) as Gate 1's consumption point

criteria.ac: Given autonomous.runner_github_token_env names a variable that is empty/unset, when runGh resolves the environment, then it warns once, leaves GH_TOKEN untouched, and records credential_source "ambient" with credential_unresolved true (no silent fallback).
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "resolveRunnerGhEnv: named-but-empty credential → credentialUnresolved, ambient, GH_TOKEN untouched (no silent fallback)" + "resolveRunnerIdentity: ambient (zero-config) → ambient source ..." (credential_unresolved true); warn-once via module-level _warnedUnresolved flag (merge-gate.js:373) — passing

criteria.ac: Given autonomous.runner_github_token_env is configured but .faffrc is malformed so loadConfig throws, when runGh resolves the environment, then it warns once with the config-read message, leaves GH_TOKEN untouched, spawns gh as the ambient identity, and records credential_source "ambient" with configFault distinct from credentialUnresolved (diagnostics keep running).
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "resolveRunnerGhEnv: a config fault forces ambient with tokenEnvName null and credentialUnresolved false" — passing; plus a live readRunnerGhConfig run against a genuinely malformed (tab-indented) .faffrc returned {tokenEnvName:null, configuredLogin:null, configFault:true} without throwing out of the reader (merge-gate.js:326-338)

criteria.ac: Given a runner credential is an App installation token (gh api user returns 403) and autonomous.runner_github_login is set, when the run resolves its identity, then the recorded github_login is the configured login with github_login_source "configured" and verified false.
criteria.verified: test/faff-1213-runner-gh-identity.test.mjs "resolveRunnerIdentity: App-token 403 (probe not authed) + configured login → configured, verified false" — passing
